items.raw_excerpt: For years France has had two tribes of holidaymakers - juilletistes and aoûtiens. But do these two traditional tribes still exist?
items.summary_en: France has traditionally had two distinct summer vacation groups: juilletistes who spend holidays in July and aoûtiens who vacation in August. This article explores whether these two classic summer tribes still exist today.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스에는 전통적으로 7월에 휴가를 보내는 쥐예티스트와 8월에 휴가를 보내는 아우티앵이라는 두 여름 휴가 집단이 있었다. 이 두 전통적인 휴가 부족이 현대에도 여전히 존재하는지 알아본다.
items.title_en: Juilletistes vs Aoûtiens: France's two summer holiday tribes

items.raw_excerpt: Denmark, and in particular Copenhagen, is famous for it's bike culture, and some foreigners are understandably eager to give the country's exceptional biking infrastructure a try. Before you jump on a bike, make sure you're aware of Danish biking etiquette, to avoid conflict with Danish cyclists.
items.summary_en: Copenhagen is known for its bike culture. Before riding, learn Danish biking etiquette to avoid conflicts with local cyclists. This guide covers the essential rules every cyclist should know.

items.raw_excerpt: A new species of crayfish has been found in Dutch rivers, the eighth type to establish itself in the Netherlands after being introduced in the upper Rhine. items.summary_en: Ecologist Pim Lemmers found the calico crayfish in Gelderland, the eighth American species to establish itself in the Netherlands. The crayfish originally comes from North America and was introduced via the upper Rhine.
items.summary_ko: 생태학자 핌 레머스가 헬데를란트에서 얼룩무늬 가재를 발견했습니다. 이는 네덜란드에 정착한 여덟 번째 미국산 가재 종입니다. 이 가재는 원래 북아메리카가 원산지이며 상류 라인강을 통해 유입되었습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Plans being considered to convert one of East Iceland’s best-known community venues into a capsule hotel have prompted a strong reaction from residents, who say the building is an irreplaceable part of Egilsstaðir’s cultural life. Owners of Hotel Valaskjálf are exploring options for the venue after extensive water damage left its main hall unusable, requiring…
items.summary_en: A historic venue in Egilsstaðir, East Iceland may become a capsule hotel after water damage. Residents are strongly opposed, saying the building is vital to the town's cultural life. The owners are considering options after the main hall was damaged by water.
